title: Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy Billing Plans and Fee Schedule
content:
Billing plans, fees and the renewal billing lead time for the Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy, by tier.

| Billing item | 1M | 2M | 3M | 4M | 5M | 10M |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Billing plans the tier may use | Annual; monthly EFT | Annual; monthly EFT | Annual; monthly EFT | Annual; monthly EFT | Annual; monthly EFT | Annual only |
| Service charge on each monthly EFT installment after the first | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 | $2.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 |
| Late fee per late installment | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $10.00 | $5.00 | $0.00 (none) |
| Days past an installment due date before a late fee is charged (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Days before expiration the renewal is billed (calendar days) | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 45 | 60 |

## Explanatory notes

- **Billing plans.** Larkspur Umbrella 1M through 5M may be billed on the annual plan or on the monthly EFT plan. Larkspur Umbrella 10M may use the annual plan only.
- **Installment service charge.** The charge attaches to each monthly EFT installment after the first; the first installment carries none. On Larkspur Umbrella 5M and 10M the charge is $0.00.
- **Late fee.** The amount charged per late installment. A figure of $0.00, as on Larkspur Umbrella 10M, means no late fee.
- **Grace days.** The number of calendar days past an installment's due date before a late fee is charged; 10 on every tier.
- **Renewal billing lead time.** The number of calendar days before expiration on which the renewal is billed: 45 on Larkspur Umbrella 1M through 5M and 60 on Larkspur Umbrella 10M.

## Basis questions

**Is a monthly EFT plan available on Larkspur Umbrella 10M?** No. The 10M tier may use the annual plan only.

**What late fee does a Larkspur Umbrella 5M installment carry?** $5.00 per late installment, against $10.00 on 1M through 4M.
